commands.message: PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT: production comes only from the Vercel Git integration on main. A command-line deploy, promote, rollback or alias is afo's step. Go ahead only on his explicit word in this session.

HOSTED DATABASE: supabase db push and supabase migration repair change the linked Supabase project, which holds real applicant data. Applying migrations to the hosted database is afo's step. Go ahead only on his explicit word in this session.

paths.message: Critical tier (.agents/merge-policy.json): never edit an applied migration; add a new one with its SQL suite assertions. Platform copies come from Weave (supabase/AGENTS.md). The merge waits for afo's go.
Critical tier: CI workflow. Keep required check names stable (.agents/merge-policy.json requiredChecks), pin actions, and never weaken a check as a workaround. The merge waits for afo's go.
